$comment: What is kept, and in what shape. `npm run generate` writes, from this file, the filter `join` installs on a participant's machine (src/telemetry-transform.mjs), the collector's configuration (collector/otelcol.yaml), which applies the same rules again, and docs/participants.md; a test fails when any is out of date. Every attribute not listed is dropped; a listed one is kept only from the services in `from` (both when absent), with the type given, and only when its value has the shape given, else it is dropped, or replaced by `otherwise`. `extract` keeps the first group of a pattern, per service. `name` marks a name the image reports only for its own tools: dropped (or replaced by `nameOther`) on a pharo-mcp span whose origin is other, and dropped on a plexus span that forwarded the call.

process.runtime.version.about: Node's major version, or Pharo's version without its build.

process.runtime.description.about: The Pharo VM's release, nothing else of its description.

deployment.environment.name.about: field for participants, eval for our own evaluation runs, preview while previewing, check for npm run check-deployment.

session.id.about: Groups the calls of one working session. The tools make it at random for each session; it is replaced by its keyed hash before it leaves your machine.

mcp.protocol.version.about: The MCP protocol version, a date.

gen_ai.tool.name.about: The tool's name, including a name the agent asked for that no tool has.

error.type.about: How a call failed: tool_error, a JSON-RPC or HTTP code, how a connection failed, a PLexus error code, or an exception class of Pharo, MCP or Node.

plexus.client.name.about: The agent host's name as it introduces itself to PLexus's server, for example claude-code.

plexus.client.version.about: The agent host's version, major and minor.

plexus.call.index.about: Where the call comes in its session: 1 for the first.

plexus.call.forwarded.about: Whether PLexus passed the call on to an image, which then names the tool.

plexus.argument.names.about: The names of the arguments a call to one of PLexus's own tools gave, never their values.

plexus.argument.unknown_names.about: Argument names a call gave that PLexus's own tool does not take.

plexus.error.code.about: Why PLexus refused a call before any image saw it.

plexus.image.save.about: Whether stopping an image saved it.

pharo.mcp.tool.origin.about: mcp for one of MCP's own tools, other for a tool another package added, unknown for a name no tool has. Names are kept only for mcp and unknown.

pharo.mcp.dispatch_path.about: How the image dispatched the request.

pharo.mcp.argument.names.about: The names of the arguments the image received, never their values.

pharo.mcp.argument.unknown_names.about: Argument names the tool does not declare.

pharo.mcp.argument.coerced.about: Argument names whose values the tool accepted in another form than its schema says.

pharo.mcp.argument.options.about: The options the call chose, as the evaluations count them: a property, a value of an enumeration, or a list given for several targets.

pharo.mcp.result.count.about: How many results a search answered.

pharo.mcp.result.more.about: Whether there were more results than answered.

pharo.mcp.tool.refs.about: The tools a discovery call (tool_search, tool_get) named.

pharo.mcp.error.kind.about: The kind of error MCP reported.

pharo.mcp.error.schema.violation_count.about: How many schema rules the arguments broke.

pharo.mcp.error.schema.paths.about: Where in the tool's input they broke them.

pharo.mcp.exception.type.about: The nearest Pharo or MCP class of an exception.

span.duration_ms.about: How long the span took, in milliseconds, kept since its times are not.
